limitations: L4 is offline synthetic software acceptance only; no assay, protein abundance, biological or clinical validity.
Welch log-delta intervals approximate arithmetic-mean ratios; independence is assumed and reference-lane uncertainty is not propagated.
Hashes cannot prove historical freeze timing or true source independence. Independent review remains unavailable.

Conservative case-insensitive English whole-word/prefix families: caus*, mechanis*, therap*, clinic*, efficac*, effective*, treat*, cure*, prevent*, recommend*, prescri*, bind*, affinit*, inhibit*, activat*, regulat*, drive/drives/driv*, induc*. Also truth, physical validity, patient benefit, protein abundan* and express*. The gate includes negations and is incomplete.
Unavailable evidence requires unavailable claims. Computed agreement and review approval cannot support positive claims. Replicated is refused.
Inputs are read-only: 64 MiB per file, 256 MiB aggregate and 4000000 JSON values; hardlink aliases share initial reads and parsing.
